Preview the child data JAMES uses internally

Source: R/preview_proeftuin.R
preview_persondata.Rd

Experimental "Proeftuin" endpoint: returns the person- or time-level data exactly as bdsreader parses it, for inspection in the app.

Usage

preview_persondata(txt = "", session = "", format = "1.0", ...)

preview_timedata(txt = "", session = "", format = "1.0", ...)

Arguments

txt

A JSON string, URL or file

session

Optional session key if data is already uploaded to sitehost.

format

String. JSON data schema version number. There are currently three schemas supported: "1.0", "1.1", "2.0", "3.0" and "3.1". Formats "1.0" and "1.1" are included for backward compatibility only. Use format = "3.1" for new applications.

...

Ignored

Value

A data frame.

See also

bdsreader::persondata(), bdsreader::timedata()

Author

Stef van Buuren 2026

Examples

fn <- system.file("testdata", "client3.json", package = "james")
preview_persondata(fn)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 16
#>      id name      dob        dobf       dobm       src   dnr   sex     gad    ga
#>   <int> <chr>     <date>     <date>     <date>     <chr> <chr> <chr> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1    -1 fa308134… 2018-10-11 1995-07-04 1990-12-02 1234  NA    fema…   189    27
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: smo <int>, bw <dbl>, hgtm <dbl>, hgtf <dbl>, agem <dbl>,
#> #   etn <chr>
preview_timedata(fn)
#> # A tibble: 11 × 8
